subject: CSuite visit — gates, attendee roster & schedule windows
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@alderbio.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@alderbio.com>, Darin Liu <darin.liu@alderbio.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CSuite visit — initial logistics questions

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for agreeing to the onsite CSuite briefing the week of Aug 30. A couple quick logistics items from our side before we lock calendars: 

- Arrival gates: our facilities team needs a short list of which external vendors / consultant teams will need freight gate access between 08:00–10:00 on Aug 30. Can you share a simplified vendor roster?
- Attendee windows: we have three executive presentation windows (08:30–09:15 PT, 11:30–12:15 PT, 15:00–15:45 PT). Do you expect the Redwood team to staff all three windows or split coverage?
- AV rehearsal: does Redwood need a 30–45 minute AV tech run-through on Aug 29? We can reserve an AV slot but need confirmation.

If easier, we can do a 20-minute sync tomorrow.

Thanks — Claire

Claire Hsu
Director, Executive Programs
Alder Bio

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@alderbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSuite visit — initial logistics questions

Hi Claire — appreciate the details. Short answers below and a few asks from our side.

- Freight gate roster: we will be bringing two Redwood teams (Ops setup team and AV techs). I can provide names and vehicle plate numbers by Aug 26. Short vendor list: Redwood Ops (2 vans), Redwood AV (1 truck).
- Presentation coverage: plan is to staff all three exec windows with one senior product lead + one customer success lead. We can split if you prefer the same people throughout; either works for us.
- AV rehearsal: yes, please reserve a 45-minute run-through on Aug 29 between 16:00–17:00 PT — we have a vendor tech arriving for cable patching.

Two small asks: can you confirm which gate has 20ft clearance (for our equipment truck) and whether the site team will provide a forklift or we should bring a small hand-crane? Also, please share the preferred SLAs for proof-of-insurance at gates (a single PDF is usually sufficient).

I'll attach a preliminary staffing list tomorrow and will coordinate finalized vehicle manifests with Marissa.

Thanks — Sean

Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@alderbio.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSuite visit — initial logistics questions

Sean / Monica — adding operational checklist and gate handoff plan. Posting the short internal runbook below so Claire has visibility to what we'll provide. 

Internal runbook (short):
- Vehicles: Ops Van A (Driver: R. Miller), Ops Van B (Driver: K. Soto), AV Truck (Driver: T. Huang). ETA 07:30 Aug 30.
- Equipment: rack kits (2), PA system (1), two podium mics, projector, power distro.
- Required gate items from Alder: gate clearance confirmation (20ft ok), forklift onsite 08:00–10:00, insurance certificate uploaded to gate portal by Aug 28.
- Staffing matrix: 08:15–09:30 (Sean + Marissa), 11:15–12:30 (Senior PM + Monica), 14:45–15:45 (Senior PM + Customer Success). We can consolidate the Senior PM across windows if needed.
- AV rehearsal: Marissa will lead. Proposed slot Aug 29 16:00–16:45 PT.

CC Claire so she can confirm forklift and gate clearance. Monica — can you assemble the final staff list with mobile numbers and email by EOD Aug 26? I will collate insurance certs and vehicle plates.

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa Cole
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Events | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@alderbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@alderbio.com>, Darin Liu <darin.liu@alderbio.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSuite visit — initial logistics questions

Thanks all — quick confirmations from Facilities and Procurement: 

- Gate clearance: West Gate has 22ft clearance (confirmed).
- Forklift: Facilities will provide a forklift from 07:45–10:30 on Aug 30; operator will be on-site.
- Insurance: procurement@alderbio.com confirmed they will accept a single Certificate of Insurance (COI) uploaded to the vendor portal. Please send by Aug 28.

Attaching the attendee roster and the site freight gate map for your ops team to review (see attachments).

Can Marissa confirm the Aug 29 rehearsal slot and Monica confirm the final staff roster by EOD Aug 26? If those two items are green, I will post the formal visit calendar invites with room assignments.

Attachment stubs: attendee_roster_aug20.csv (csv), venue_freight_gate_map_v2.pdf (pdf)

Claire Hsu
Director, Executive Programs
Alder Bio
